results.corrected_title: OpenAI opens ChatGPT Spaces to Plus subscribers
results.corrected_summary: OpenAI made Spaces, a shared workspace in ChatGPT, available to ChatGPT Plus subscribers (USD 20/month) from 20 November 2026. Before this it was limited to Pro, Business and Enterprise. Spaces holds files and project material, includes the new Pages document format, supports inviting collaborators, and works with Scheduled Tasks.
key_facts: Available to Plus from 20 Nov 2026; previously Pro, Business and Enterprise only
Pages is a new document format
Works with Scheduled Tasks and supports inviting collaborators

results.corrected_title: Commission seeks feedback on draft AI Act fundamental rights impact assessment template
results.corrected_summary: On 16 November 2026 the European Commission published a draft template for the fundamental rights impact assessment (FRIA) under Article 27 of the AI Act and opened a feedback round. The AI Office prepared it with input from the EU Fundamental Rights Agency. Feedback is open until 15 January 2027, and deployers interested in testing it have until 4 December 2026 to express interest. Deployers must comply from 2 December 2027.
key_facts: Prepared by the AI Office with input from the FRA
Deadline to volunteer to test: 4 Dec 2026

results.corrected_title: Australia: unemployment rises to 4.9% amid job cuts; APRA to stress-test AI scenarios
results.corrected_summary: ABC News reported on 21 Nov 2026 that Australian unemployment rose to 4.9% in October. Seasonally adjusted employment fell by 43,500. The article cites layoffs across retail, banks, airlines and tech, with AI investment named as one driver among restructuring and offshoring. APRA will run stress tests on hypothetical AI-related scenarios.
key_facts: AI investment cited as one cause alongside restructuring and offshoring; no data on AI's share
APRA to stress-test hypothetical AI scenarios; no scope or timing
